verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents syncing to 300+ destinations in real time or on a schedule. Each sync connects one model to one destination object and defines how rows map into it, with field mapping configurable in the app or via API. Collected events land in the warehouse and can be modeled with SQL, dbt or a visual builder and then synced downstream, which gives per-destination selection through the model definition. Missing for 10: direct event-stream forwarding to destinations (events route through the warehouse and syncs), explicit per-destination filtering docs beyond SQL model definition, per-destination integration docs in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth (community cites only 70+ integrations at an earlier date).
